purpose: Independent exact-ID primary-source check of the fresh six-pair novelty fixture bank, before prospective registration or performance calls.
source_method: One unauthenticated public NCBI E-utilities efetch.fcgi request for db=pubmed, the exact twelve preregistered PMID anchors, retmode=xml; parsed PubmedArticle records and abstracts locally. This was metadata/abstract reading only, not PubMed search, query testing, candidate screening, or an MCP/runner experiment.

verified_metadata.title: CRISPR antiphage defence mediated by the cyclic nucleotide-binding membrane protein Csx23

records.claim_boundary: Abstract supports cA4 binding, transmembrane-domain perturbation, and defense with the cognate type III system in E. coli. Avoid implying native in-vivo Vibrio demonstration.

verified_metadata.title: Ion selectivity and rotor coupling of the Vibrio flagellar sodium-driven stator unit

records.claim_boundary: Abstract reports PomAB sodium-binding sites and a dynamic PomA helical motif regulating stator activation and torque transmission. It does not phrase this simply as Na+ binding plus PomA conformational changes coupling ion transport.

verified_metadata.title: Molecular condensation of the CO/NF-YB/NF-YC/FT complex gates floral transition in Arabidopsis

records.claim_boundary: Abstract supports CO/NF-YB2/NF-YC9/FT co-phase separation and FT transcriptional activation; “maintain FT transcription” is less exact than the abstract wording.

verified_metadata.title: Lsr2 acts as a cyclic di-GMP receptor that promotes keto-mycolic acid synthesis and biofilm formation in mycobacteria

records.claim_boundary: Abstract supports c-di-GMP binding to Lsr2, HadD upregulation, keto-mycolic-acid synthesis and biofilm formation. No correction needed.

verified_metadata.title: Roles for diacylglycerol in synaptic vesicle priming and release revealed by complete reconstitution of core protein machinery
verified_metadata.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

records.claim_boundary: Abstract supports DAG-dependent acceleration of Ca2+-triggered release and Munc13/Munc18-mediated SNAREpin assembly. “DAG activates Munc13” is stronger than the abstract states.

verified_metadata.title: SpoIVA is an essential morphogenetic protein for the formation of heat- and lysozyme-resistant spores in Clostridium sporogenes NBRC 14293

records.claim_boundary: Abstract supports SpoIVA-dependent spore morphogenesis, coat/exosporium misassembly after inactivation, and loss of heat/lysozyme resistance. No correction needed.

verified_metadata.title: In situ architecture of Opa1-dependent mitochondrial cristae remodeling

records.claim_boundary: Abstract says increased l-Opa1 promotes crista stacking and increased s-Opa1 correlates with irregular packing. Draft preserves the causal/correlational distinction.

verified_metadata.title: Regulation of minimal spindle midzone organization by mitotic kinases

records.claim_boundary: Abstract assigns antiparallel-microtubule affinity control to CDK1-phosphorylated PRC1; PLK1 regulates its own recruitment by PRC1. Draft incorrectly attributes the binding effect jointly to CDK1 and PLK1.

verified_metadata.title: CELLULOSE SYNTHASE-LIKE C proteins modulate cell wall establishment during ethylene-mediated root growth inhibition in rice

records.claim_boundary: Abstract supports direct OsEIL1 activation of OsCSLC1/2/7/9 and OsCSLC2-linked xyloglucan synthesis; it says this likely restricts cell-wall extension and elongation, so hedge the outcome.

verified_metadata.title: The ARPKD Protein DZIP1L Regulates Ciliary Protein Entry by Modulating the Architecture and Function of Ciliary Transition Fibers

records.claim_boundary: Abstract supports DZIP1L/ANKRD26 roles in transition-fiber assembly and ciliary gating for soluble and membrane proteins, with conservation in mammalian cilia. No necessary correction.

verified_metadata.title: Unveiling the A-to-I mRNA editing machinery and its regulation and evolution in fungi

records.claim_boundary: Abstract supports FgTad2-FgTad3 A-to-I mRNA editing in Fusarium graminearum and dependence on interaction with sexual-stage-specific Ame1. No correction needed.

verified_metadata.title: Control of meiotic crossover interference by a proteolytic chaperone network

records.claim_boundary: Abstract supports HCR3/J3-HSP70 network-mediated HEI10 proteolysis regulating crossover interference in Arabidopsis. No correction needed.

changes_before_registration.before: In Vibrio type III CRISPR immunity, cA4 binding to membrane effector Csx23 perturbs its transmembrane domain and activates antiphage defense.
changes_before_registration.after: Vibrio cholerae Csx23 binds cA4, perturbing its transmembrane domain and providing immunity with its cognate type III CRISPR system in E. coli.

changes_before_registration.before: In Vibrio sodium-driven flagellar motors, Na+ binding and PomA conformational changes couple ion transport to PomAB stator activation and torque transmission.
changes_before_registration.after: In the Vibrio PomAB flagellar stator, sodium-binding sites support ion selectivity, while a dynamic PomA helical motif regulates stator activation and torque transmission.

changes_before_registration.before: Arabidopsis CO coassembles with NF-YB2, NF-YC9 and FT into condensates that maintain FT transcription during floral transition.
changes_before_registration.after: In Arabidopsis, CO coassembles with NF-YB2, NF-YC9 and FT in condensates that regulate FT transcription and floral transition.

changes_before_registration.before: Diacylglycerol activates Munc13 to accelerate SNARE assembly and calcium-triggered synaptic-vesicle release.
changes_before_registration.after: In reconstituted synaptic-release machinery, DAG accelerates Munc13/Munc18-mediated SNAREpin assembly and Ca2+-dependent vesicle release.

changes_before_registration.before: CDK1 and PLK1 phosphorylation tune PRC1 binding to antiparallel microtubules, enabling reversible assembly of a minimal anaphase midzone.
changes_before_registration.after: CDK1 phosphorylation controls PRC1 affinity for antiparallel microtubules, and PRC1 dephosphorylation triggers minimal anaphase-midzone reorganization with KIF4A.

changes_before_registration.before: In rice roots, OsEIL1 directly activates OsCSLC genes; OsCSLC2 promotes ethylene-induced xyloglucan synthesis that restricts cell elongation.
changes_before_registration.after: In rice roots, OsEIL1 directly activates OsCSLC genes; OsCSLC2 promotes ethylene-induced xyloglucan synthesis that likely restricts cell elongation.

distinctness.draft_corpus_check: Compared against 83 draft/idea/text-like strings in references/external/sakana JSON; none had token Jaccard overlap >=0.18 with a proposed draft. Core v1/v2 fixture and earlier result-conditioned bank strings were included.
distinctness.scientific_distinctness_boundary: Pair-level distinction assesses the source-verified abstract claims and supplied mechanisms; broad shared-context caveats remain: Vibrio/membrane for Csx23/PomAB, cellular architecture for Opa1/PRC1, and reproductive biology for fungal editing/HCR3. This does not predict retrieval overlap.

prior_access_history: Initial official PubMed HTML batch: one full abstract visible, three titles surfaced without body, eight were blocked/empty/error. One batched DOI-URL correction also failed. The exact-ID E-utilities read resolved those access limitations without recaptcha bypass.
unassessed_gates: candidate exact-target recall versus static baseline
limits: Verification is at the PubMed-indexed abstract boundary; this is not full-text causal adjudication or expert scientific validation.
Metadata verification uses one exact-ID public NCBI E-utilities batch response; the original HTML access failures are retained in primary_source_review.prior_attempt_history.

Distinctness compares the proposed control mechanisms and the dossier corpus; no queries, retrieval results, eligibility, static/candidate baselines, hit retention, cross-pair hits, blinded-unrelated fraction, provenance completeness, or performance were assessed.

All twelve PMIDs and drafts are distinct from exact IDs/draft-like strings found in the tracked Sakana dossier; the previously recorded 83-string lexical comparison remains a corpus distinctness aid, not a scientific novelty judgment.
